findings.claim_text: A direct 26.8% versus 19% comparison is not a controlled benchmark because targets, CRO/assay methodology, design budgets and the era of the underlying generators differ.
RFdiffusion (Watson et al., Nature 2023) reported an overall experimental binder success rate of 19%.
354 of 1,320 designs bound their targets, a hit rate of 26.8% by the integrated call.
